name: signal-tear
title: Signal Tear
description: A grainy picture whose rows tear sideways and drag light into a ghost trail, like a bad VHS still.

props.description: A figure that owns one Canvas. Size it with className.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. A cross-origin image needs CORS headers (Access-Control-Allow-Origin).

props.name: focus
props.description: Point of the image kept in frame when the crop fills the stage. 0 to 1, y counted from the top.

props.name: ink
props.description: Shadow tone. Any three.js color string.

props.name: paper
props.description: Light tone.

props.name: tear
props.description: How often and how far rows tear, 0 to 1. Rows near the pointer tear first.

props.name: ghost
props.description: Length of the light trail, 0 to 1.

props.name: grain
props.description: Film grain, 0 to 1. 0 turns it off.

props.name: paused
props.description: Holds one still frame and stops rendering.

props.name: label
props.default: "A grainy picture whose rows tear sideways and leave light trails near the pointer"
props.description: Accessible name.

props.name: className
props.description: Give the stage a size.
Full-frame plane without the Canvas. Mount it alone in a Canvas or a drei View. Reads state.pointer. The tear follows the pointer and drifts on its own after 2.5 seconds without a move.

accessibility: A figure with an accessible name. The canvas is hidden from assistive tech.
Without WebGL it shows the source image in grayscale.

animation.timing: Always while visible, on demand offscreen or paused

animation.properties: Row offset in the fragment shader
animation.timing: Bands reshuffle three times a second, grain twelve
animation.trigger: Time, pointer position and pointer speed

docs: Requires React 19 and an image your page can read as a texture. Render <SignalTear src="/photo.jpg" className="w-full max-w-xl" /> anywhere. SignalTear owns a Canvas, so mount SignalTearScene inside an existing Canvas or drei View when a page already has one.
